hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && cat > .gitignore << 'EOF'
.env
.env.local
.env.*.local
node_modules
.next
out
coverage
*.log
EOF
if [ ! -f .eslintrc.js ]; then cat > .eslintrc.js << 'EOF'
module.exports = {
  extends: ['next/core-web-vitals', 'eslint:recommended', 'plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended'],
  rules: {
    '@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any': 'error',
    'no-unused-vars': ['error', { argsIgnorePattern: '^_' }]
  }
};
EOF
fi
if [ ! -f .prettierrc ]; then cat > .prettierrc << 'EOF'
{
  "semi": true,
  "tabWidth": 2,
  "singleQuote": true,
  "trailingComma": "esm",
  "printWidth": 120
}
EOF
fi
echo "Next.js 前端开发规范初始化完成，已添加基础配置"
